Name: Hill of Hachilah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the wilderness of Ziph
Description: A hill in the wilderness of Ziph, on the south of Jeshimon, where David hid from Saul, and where Saul camped while hunting him.
BiblicalSignificance: Hachilah is one of the hiding places of David's fugitive years, where he twice spared Saul's life.
